# Numbers estimates per project: EST-<project>-REV01, REV02, ...
n = frappe.db.count("Fit Out BOQ", {"project": doc.project}) + 1
while frappe.db.exists("Fit Out BOQ", "EST-" + doc.project + "-REV" + str(n).zfill(2)):
    n = n + 1
doc.rev_no = str(n).zfill(2)
doc.revision = n

script:
if doc.work_package and frappe.db.exists("Fit Out Work Package", doc.work_package):
    req = frappe.db.get_value("Fit Out Work Package", doc.work_package, "inspection_required")
    last = frappe.get_all("Fit Out Inspection", filters={"work_package": doc.work_package, "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"]}, fields=["status"], order_by="modified desc", limit=1)
    st = "Not Applicable" if not req else (last[0].status if last else "Not Requested")
    frappe.db.set_value("Fit Out Work Package", doc.work_package, "inspection_status", st, update_modified=False)

Fit Out Workflow Stage - Sync Options
script:
# Keeps the Project 'Fit Out Stage' dropdown in step with the configured lifecycle stages.
rows = frappe.get_all("Fit Out Workflow Stage", filters={"is_active": 1}, fields=["stage_name"], order_by="sequence asc")
opts = "\n" + "\n".join([r.stage_name for r in rows]) + "\nCompleted"
cf = frappe.get_doc("Custom Field", "Project-fo_stage")
if cf.options != opts:
    cf.options = opts
    cf.save(ignore_permissions=True)
